name: daily-karte

scripts.check: node --check dist/app.js && node --check dist/model.js && node --check dist/icons.js && node --check dist/account.js && node --check dist/cloud.js && node --check dist/sync-state.js && node --check dist/site-config.js && node --check dist/schema.js && node --check dist/pwa.js && node --check dist/sw.js
scripts.lint: eslint web dist tests scripts packages/core/src packages/core/tests eslint.config.mjs
